rationale: Luke's full-stack engineering background and conviction around AI-powered automation tooling complement Georgi's push to make agentic workflow automation the default for early-stage teams at Rilo. Luke's experience building AI products across edtech and generative video, combined with his hands-on Python/TypeScript stack, could bring fresh perspective to Rilo's multi-agent GTM automation platform—and Georgi's proven ability to run hackathons and drive community-led distribution aligns with how Luke approaches positive-sum collaboration and building for creators.
intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Georgi—you're both building automation-first tools in SF and share conviction that AI agents should fundamentally reshape how teams work; Luke's full-stack founding experience and Georgi's GTM automation platform could spark something interesting.
